Are we really still doing this?

nodes.prompt: Are we really still doing this?

options.label: Are we really still doing this?
I'll show you something to fear!

nodes.text: Coach Lancely continues to pace.

options.label: The Gryphon should be put down.
The Gryphon should be set free.

nodes.text: Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: At least, this class will be educational.
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: We better learn how to break stuff.
Several days later. A clear crisp morning.
You stand at attention, shoulder to shoulder with your other classmates, as Coach Jaque Lancely paces in front of you, barking out his lessons in gruff, gravelly tones.

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Welcome to Psychical Education, you imp farts! My name is Professor Jaque Lancely.

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Drop and give me twenty!
The class drops to the ground to do push-ups. Coach Lancely observes the exercise, puffing out his chest.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well... `Urgg...` At least this class won't be `boring...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... [i]Urgg...[/i] At least this class won't be [i]boring...[/i]

nodes.text: Your friend Arinna, Princess of the Wildefolke, nods in agreement.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Indeed. I find our instructor's manner most comforting. Almost a taste of home, but kinder... `Gentler.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Indeed. I find our instructor's manner most comforting. Almost a taste of home, but kinder... [i]Gentler.[/i]

nodes.text: Coach Lancely hoo-hahs and beats his chest.

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Now back on your feet. You'll rest when I say and not one moment before.
The class rises. On your other side, Simon shakes out his tired arms.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Did you say `gentler?`

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Now I know what you're thinking. This is a `school.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I know what you're thinking. This is a [i]school.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: But I'm here to tell you that magic is `not` something you can master from inside a classroom. Magic is a part of who you are. Up `here.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm here to tell you that magic is [i]not[/i] something you can master from inside a classroom. Magic is a part of who you are. Up [i]here.[/i]

nodes.text: Coach Lancely taps his temple.

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Down here...
He taps his heart.

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: And especially here!
He flexes, showing off a large, rippling bicep!

Instinctively, you glance down at your own slender arms, catching a glimpse of the bracelet on your wrist, and the gems inlaid into it that tracks your emotional alignment. Currently, the gem glows a brilliant...
And now...
The wee morning hours.
You and Luke sit atop the tallest spire of SpellClaive Academy, School for Magic. By your feet is a picnic basket and a chilling bottle of Barron's Bubblegum Brew.
Overhead, $NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops and gambols in the gentle updrafts alongside your boyfriend's familiar, a winged snake named Copernicus.
Your boyfriend Luke offers you a glass brimming with pinkish, bubble-gum flavored liquid. You take a quick, polite sip and then set the rest aside.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, you just got awfully quiet. Is there something wrong? Were the snacks I picked out all right?
Luke begins to rise.
You yank him by the wrist, pulling him right back down next to you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, Luke, everything's `perfect.` Just sit next to me for a second.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Luke, everything's [i]perfect.[/i] Just sit next to me for a second.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Okay. Sitting. I can do sitting.
You head rests against his broad shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, you know that my time living with foster families was difficult, right?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I know you don't really like to talk about it...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Which is okay. You don't have to talk, if you don't want to. Everybody's got secrets.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's the whole point, Luke. I `want` to talk about it. I don't want any secrets between us. I `trust` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the whole point, Luke. I [i]want[/i] to talk about it. I don't want any secrets between us. I [i]trust[/i] you.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yeah? I'm glad.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Me too. And what I want to say is this. Back then I never could've imagined that I'd be someplace like this... With someone like `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too. And what I want to say is this. Back then I never could've imagined that I'd be someplace like this... With someone like [i]you.[/i]

nodes.text: You lean in and press your lips to his.
His arm wraps around your waist, drawing you close. His other hand brushes your cheek.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No, it's just what you said... You `trust` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's just what you said... You [i]trust[/i] me.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah... So?
Luke hops to his feet and extends his hand. You take it, and he draws you up to your feet. Still holding your hand, he ushers you to the edge of the roof.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: So trust me.
Luke lifts you off your feet, carrying you like a bride over a threshold.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, what are you doing? We could fall off!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I thought you said you `trusted` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you said you [i]trusted[/i] me.

nodes.text: He steps off the edge.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, this really isn't...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `...Funny?`
You don't drop. Instead, you both float ever so slowly down to the grass below. When Luke's feet gently alight on the soft lawn, he puts you down.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: How'd you do that?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Easy. We both drank a bit of Barron's Bubblegum Brew. Tasty, and it also makes you light as a bubble. Well, at least until...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `--BURP!`

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Good thing you didn't do that on the way down!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Or I would've had to do something dashing and clever, and then you would've fallen hopelessly in love with me.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah? And what would be so bad about that?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Nothing, actually...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: In fact, it's all part of the plan.
The sun peaks over the horizon. Sunbeams glint dazzlingly off the fresh morning dew. Then the first bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, that's it. One perfect night is over. And now...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Class.`
Order Way Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Clara... Trans... Luceo!`
Chaos Way Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Duo... Dupli... Care!`
Which advanced spell did you learn?
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Typhon... Turbi... Nus!`
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Electro... Con... Ductus!`
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You calm down!
You rush Priam, swing the staff wildly! He deflects your blows and then sidesteps...
As you move past him, he swings his staff into the small of your back.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `AAHH!`
You sprawl face first down onto the soft mat. You roll over, lying flat, heart racing, breath caged tight in your chest...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uhh... I feel...
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Drop the mind games, Sigmund Fraud. I'm done!
You toss the staff at Priam, and spin on your heels, racing out of the training facility.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: No... $CADY, `wait!`
You round the corner, heading toward your room when...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uhh... I... I feel...
Your legs buckle beneath you, and as if in a dream, you feel yourself collide with the soft earth. Your heart races, and sweat lines your brow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Nnnh...`
You hesitate... Eyeing Priam and then the exit...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uhh... I... I feel...
Your legs buckle beneath you, and as if in a dream, you feel yourself hit the soft mat. Your heart races, and sweat lines your brow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nnnh...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Electro... Con... Ductus!`
You raise the staff horizontally, with hands in a wide grip, and block the vertical attack!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Good. Now acknowledge that which troubles you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What? What are you talking--
Images flood your mind. You're sitting in the front seat of a car with your mother and brother. A truck screams in from the side. As it impacts--
You're catapulted through a series of foster homes, enduring in succession a thousand slights and cruelties...
And then you're back, squaring off against Priam! He jerks his staff back, and then swipes in from the side!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Horizontal slash! Counter with a `cross block!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Horizontal slash! Counter with a [i]cross block![/i]

args.text: Cross block!
Rising block!

nodes.text: You raise your staff upward... And Priam smashes the end of his staff into your guts!
You hesitate... And Priam smashes the end of his staff into your guts!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Uuhf!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Oh come on!`
Priam attacks again!
You hold the staff vertically, neatly blocking the horizontal attack!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Good! Now focus on what you've accomplished!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What are you doing to--
More images whiz into your mind! You're practicing spells!
You hesitate... And Priam smashes the end of his staff down on your shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Hey!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `That really hurts!`
Priam attacks again!
Priam extends a hand to help you up.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Rise.
Reluctantly, you take Priam's hand. With a surprisingly strong tug, he lifts you onto your feet. He steps to a rack of weapons and selects an ornate training staff for you.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Here. This is for you, your `Phall'anxra.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Here. This is for you, your [i]Phall'anxra.[/i]

nodes.text: The staff is as long as you are tall and an inch and a half in diameter. Heavy, but with a good weight. Down the whole of its length are inscribed runes that appear to gleam with their own flickering light.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, this thing is pretty cool. When do I get to whack stuff?

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: There will be no... Whacking. There will be `listening.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There will be no... Whacking. There will be [i]listening.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right. Because that's so much more fun.
Priam strides over to you, close, looking down... A full head taller than you. From this distance, his scent, woodsy, with floral undertones of exotic jungle blossoms, fills your nose.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You are now my Phall'anx, my shield-bearer.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You must swear to learn, to do as I command, and in return, I swear to protect you and offer instruction.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Not too keen on the 'doing as you command' part...

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Your answer.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whatever. Sure, fine, I `swear...`
In your hand, the staff glows brightly. You feel the universe blur, turning soft focus and then snapping back with razor-sharp clarity!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Huh? I feel...
Priam takes a step back, spinning his staff fluidly.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: The first lesson is simple. Set aside your fear.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, like I'm really afraid of `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, like I'm really afraid of [i]you.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You should be. `Defend yourself!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Defend my who now--

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: `YAAHHHH!!!`
Priam levels a downward strike, bashing your shoulder from above! You stumble back, and he charges forward to attack again!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Downward strike! Counter with a `rising block!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Downward strike! Counter with a [i]rising block![/i]

nodes.text: You duck under the horizontal blow!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ha!
But not the follow up sweep that yanks your feet out from beneath you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: UFF... `HEY!`
Priam spins the staff and then holsters it underneath his arm in a fluid gesture.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Unskilled... But quick on your feet. Perhaps there's something here I can work with.
The staff bashes against your neck, knocking you off your feet! You land with a thump!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `OW!`
Priam spins the staff and then holsters it underneath his arm in a fluid gesture.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Remember this. Those who lack discipline are their own worst enemy.
You roll into a seated position, rubbing the rising welt on your shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Are you sure? Because I'd say I was looking at my own worst enemy right now.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You are unskilled, yes. But you do have passion.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Knowing exactly what others are doing at all times is not always the blessing it would first seem.
The Social Calendar displays a picture of Arinna and states that she is performing the Mo'Anna invocation.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Regardless, I am delighted you seem in such high spirits!

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: I'd heard such early morning walks referred to as shameful, but who could be ashamed of time spent in the glorious outdoors?
Arinna nods to the bundle underneath your arm.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Is that a gift from Luke?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke? No. Why would it--

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: You did have another romantic evening planned, did you not?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Did we?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no, I got so flustered in Enchanted Objects class that I totally forgot. I'm like the worst girlfriend ever!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, that's a little harsh.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Luke?
You whip your head around, but the path behind you is empty.

Then a shadow passes over you from above. A floating gondola with a picnic basket sets down just outside the suite you share with Arinna. Trailing behind is a string quartet of musicianless instruments. Luke is at the bow of the gondola, his eyebrows furrowed.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The worst girlfriend in the world is probably Marionne Hobskillet.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: She made her rich boyfriends buy her cars and jewels, and then she turned them into feral cats.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You just `didn't` respond to my texts.
nodes.text_bbcode: You just [i]didn't[/i] respond to my texts.

nodes.text: Luke points at the package.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Is that what distracted you?
You unwrap the cloth and reveal the $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE to Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Very impressive!
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey Arinna, looks like you're up early too!

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: I am `always` up early. The rites of the Mo'Anna Invocation demand it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [i]always[/i] up early. The rites of the Mo'Anna Invocation demand it.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: But seeing `you` up at this hour is more... Unusual.
nodes.text_bbcode: But seeing [i]you[/i] up at this hour is more... Unusual.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...
You tip-toe toward the door.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: $CADY, is that you?
You open the door, step in, and then step out again, as if you'd just opened the door from the inside.
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yep, just me... Waking up...
You fake yawn.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `YAAAWNN...` See?

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: `Unlikely...` I know you did not sleep in your room last night. You, how do they say, snore like a fart train.
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Unlikely...[/i] I know you did not sleep in your room last night. You, how do they say, snore like a fart train.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You better mean `freight` train.
Tucked under your arm, wrapped in a towel, is the Social Calendar.
Still giddy and nervous, you race up the path to the suite you share with Princess Arinna.

nodes.text: That is not to diminish the difficulties.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: However, the bond of the Phall'anx has given me... Insight. She has endured much for one so young.
Elsewhere, on campus...
Headmaster Cromwell and Precept Priam conference in private, their voices kept just above a whisper.

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: It is good to hear the training has gone apace, so far at least.
Chaos Way Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Might as well give it a shot...
You close your eyes, and when you open them again you try to visualize the class naked. In your mind, students watch you from their seats, still waiting expectantly, but now completely unclothed.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ew... `Mole...`
On the wall, a portrait of a prim older lady comes alive and blubbers, flustered.

nodes.speaker: Painting
nodes.text: Impure thoughts!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It was an event, scheduled for right now, and it involved the whole school...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: The event was... `Fear.`

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: What do you mean by 'fear'?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't know. All I know is--
Your stomach clenches, causing you to double over. The sound of a thousand, tiny, skittering legs rises in your ears.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ahh!`
A thick, pulsing wave of spiders passes between your ankles, angling toward the shadows in the back of the classroom. From the darkness comes a low, guttural growl.
A pair of gleaming, golden eyes appears.
The eyes inch forward, and bearing them, a terrifying face slips into view.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: `Hrrr... Hope I'm not too late for class.`
The $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE flips rapidly through its pages, and there's a blinding flash of light! Visions flood through your head!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `AHHHHH!`

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: `NOOOOO!`

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: `NNNGGG!`
The room returns to normal.

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Quickly, $CADY, tell me. What did it show you?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder do some rudimentary divination, which I guess is pretty useful if you want to make money betting on wizardball.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder to listen to memories, which I guess is pretty useful if you lose your wand a lot.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder to keep track of social events, which I guess is pretty useful if you're pretty full of yourself... Isn't that right, Minka?

nodes.speaker: Enchantress Pelydryn
nodes.text: Wait... Is that mine? Did you steal that from the vault?
The class snorts with laughter.

nodes.speaker: Enchantress Pelydryn
nodes.text: I mean, ha ha... Why would someone as popular as me need that?
A few scattered, polite giggles.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Huh... The class is laughing. This is going better than I expected!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so the next thing to remember about the $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE is where it came from...
You continue talking for the next few minutes.
As you finish, Professor Pelydryn rises from her seat and approaches the $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE appraisingly.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder do some rudimentary divination, which... Is not right at all, is it?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder to listen to memories, which... Is not right at all, is it?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Allows its wielder to keep track of social events, which... Is not right at all, is it?
Simon and Arinna shake their heads from side to side.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Crap.`
Titters of amusement rise up from the classroom. Minka smirks triumphantly to the rest of her clique.

nodes.speaker: Enchantress Pelydryn
nodes.text: Told you she'd choke.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm not choking, Minka, I'm just, uh...
In the audience, Simon and Arinna shake their heads.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Crap.`
Professor Pelydryn rises from her seat and approaches the $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE appraisingly.

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: I must admit, this is a very fine specimen. I'm surprised Librarian Bodney allowed you to check it out.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: The only one that I've seen that was nearly as preserved is currently locked up tight in the SpellClaive vau--

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: `Hold up!`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, so about Librarian Bodney `allowing...`

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: `Shhh...` Be quiet! It's doing something!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...It is?
In Enchanted Objects class...
You take a seat just as the second bell signals the start of class. Enchantress Pelydryn rises and approaches the front of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Today, we will continue our extended overview of Cursed Coins and Bewitched Books, but first...

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: $CADY had an Enchanted Object she wanted to present.
You rise, carrying your bundle to the front of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so, um... This is a $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE, and it, uh... `Umm...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so, um... This is a $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE, and it, uh... [i]Umm...[/i]

nodes.text: Blank expectant stares.

args.text: It can tell the future.
It brings back memories.
It keeps track of friends.

nodes.text: You hesitate, petrified!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Uh...
Titters of amusement rise up from the classroom. Minka smirks triumphantly to her friends.

nodes.speaker: Enchantress Pelydryn
nodes.text: Told you she'd choke.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm not choking, Minka, I'm just, uh...
Around the side of the building, you hear a melodious female voice rising up to the heavens, reciting from memory the Mo'Anna Invocation.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Kali'ama Katee Katem Sol'wa...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh oh... Arinna will have questions if she sees I was out all night.

options.label: Just tell me how to kill it.
It's okay if you don't know.
I'll tell Arinna about the song.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: But I have never seen one of `those` in the library.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I have never seen one of [i]those[/i] in the library.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sure, but... I have an Enchanted Object for my presentation. Isn't that all that matters?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Maybe.
You turn to Luke, and in doing so, angle the $ENCHANTEDITEMYOUSTOLE in his direction. He takes a casual step back from it. Then another.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Just... Be careful with that...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Enchanted Objects like that one have been known to be `unreliable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Enchanted Objects like that one have been known to be [i]unreliable.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: How so?
Arinna leans in to examine the object.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Relax, guys. Like I said, this thing is just for the presentation. I've got everything under control.

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: `Everything?` Is that so?

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: And there is not some place that you are scheduled to be right now?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Where would I need to be this early? It's not like I've got a--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh oh!
You speed across the campus and into the combat studio.
Priam waits at the far end of the room, facing away from you, kneeling before an altar of lit candles. In one hand, he holds a staff.
He speaks, still facing away.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You're late. Tardiness bespeaks a lack of discipline.
Priam wheels around, swinging his staff horizontally right at your head!
Selecting your familiar!
And you're with Priam once again! His staff pushes against your own. He uses his strength to force you back! You strain, feeling your feet inch backward!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Now push it aside! Push everything aside!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I can't... `I...`

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Do it!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `AAAHH!!!`
Your feet slip out from under you, and you sprawl backward!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: What--

Apero
Hold on... Did you forget the password?
No, I didn't. Just give me a second to think.
`Apricot... Apeface...` I know it was an A word, definitely an A word...
Score Up!
`Apero!`
The vault door rumbles open, and you and Luke slide quickly inside.
You know, they really oughtta upgrade security around this school.
Tell me about it.
You and Luke make your way quickly through the vault, passing shelves crammed full of enchanted objects, on your way to the door at the far end of the room.
This is it... The Wildestone is in here.
You force open the door, revealing a sparse chamber illuminated by candles placed in floorstanding brass candleholders.
A stone platform occupies the whole of the center of the room, and in front of it stands a pedastal. Resting atop the pedastal is a glimmering emerald `jewel.`
We really need to talk about this plan of yours.
From everything I've heard, it takes months to open a portal to the Wilde. There's no way that you'll just be able to--
As you step near, a buzzing sensation rises in your gut and between your ears. The jewel seems to glint, and then it begins to `glow.`
Wh-what's happening?
I don't know. I... I feel like I'm standing in two places at once.
Without thinking, your hand draws toward the jewel.
Make your choice!
Touch it!
What do you do?
Your fingers brush against its cool, smooth facets and--
`KZZZTT!`
`Ow!` Why does everything in this stupid school always have to zap the everloving crap out of--
$CADY... `LOOK!`
Sparks arc from your fingertips to the Wildestone!
The Wildestone vibrates, the whole room shudders, and a circle etched in the stone platform begins to glow! Over the circle, a rippling portal opens.
Through it, a small clearing in a forest can be seen.
The Wilde... You did it!
Now's our chance. We can step through before it can get to us.
Luke, I told you. I'm not going. The Wildestalker is.
Now we just need to figure out a way to corral Toothy the Tiger into the portal before it can--
Temper temper.
You turn to see the Wildestalker pad into the chamber, sliding through the solid door like it wasn't even there. A paralyzing fear grips you, like an ice-cold hand clutching your heart in a fist.
Now now, is that any way to speak about your family?
Wh-what are you talking about?
Weren't you paying attention when your Headmaster explained what I am?
No, probably not. You've never been a terribly attentive student.
I'm a construct of magic and flesh summoned to waking life by a `necromancer...`
Using beasts of the forest like mortar, Wildewalkers like bricks.
And `who` do you think those Wildewalkers were? Whose blood do you think runs through my veins?
Why is it that I can `find` you wherever you are? Why is it that I `know` you intimately?
Maybe because you're a creepy creeper. Who cares?
Oh, I think you do.
You see, over the years, I've made a few improvements to myself, using materials at hand.
The Wildestalker opens its mouth as if to roar, but instead its jaw unhinges at the joints, folding backward to an obtuse angle.

Its throat opens up into a cavernous pit, and at the bottom is a platform shrouded in mist, populated with the pitiable, lumbering, moaning shades... `Wildewalkers.` Their essences, at least. Their `souls` trapped.
As one, the shades look up, their voices rising up in unison.
Shades
`JOIN USSSSZZZZ... BECOME USSSSZZZZ...`
Among the shades one figure remains silent, a `phantom` with a familiar face...
A face you thought you'd never see again.
Dad, is that you?
Phantom
`...Little One?`
Dad, what happened? Where did you--
The phantom looks up with hollow eyes, its voice joining the chorus!
Phantom
`$CADY... JOIN USSSZZZZ...`
No no `nonono...`
You stumble back, the fist of fear gripping your heart becoming a coiled snake that constricts ever tighter.
`RAAAWWWRRR!!!`
The Wildestalker leaps forward, swinging its right paw at you from the side -- a `horizontal slash!`
Acting on instinct, you grab a nearby sceptre, gripping it in two hands like a staff. You perform a--
Hurry!
Rising block!|Cross block!|Spin around!
Defend yourself!
You counter the onrushing blow with a `Cross Block!`
Score Up!
`NNH!`
Even so, you nearly lose your footing under the weight of the attack.
The Wildestalker roars, kneels forward, and whips its tail at you like a scorpion in a `downward strike!`
Hurry!
Cower fearfully!|Rising block!|Cross block!|Spin around!
Defend yourself!
You lift the sceptre over your head in a `Rising Block!`
But the blow comes from the side!
`AHHHH!`
Claws rake open the flesh at your midsection!
You hesitate, stricken by fear!
You pivot on your heels! Before you can move out of the way, the blow comes from the side!
You ward off the venomous stinger with a `Rising Block!`

Watch where you point that thing!
The prehensile tail wraps around the sceptre and rips it from your grip! The tail flings the sceptre aside!
You position the sceptre vertically in a `Cross Block!`
But the attack come from above!
`AHHHH!`
The stinger plunges into the soft flesh of your neck! A surging chill travels down your throat, into your heart, and disperses into your bloodstream.
You hesitate, paralyzed by terror!
You pivot on your heels! Before you can move out of the way, the blow comes in from the side!
